summary_1line: Upamanyu recounts Rishi Tandi’s long penance and ecstatic hymn praising Shiva as the supreme, all-encompassing reality behind creation, time, gods, and liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: After ten thousand years of austerities, the sage Tandi beholds the radiant and ineffable form of Mahadeva appearing before him.
The ascetic Tandi stands with folded hands in the wilderness, offering a vast hymn as Shiva’s luminous presence fills the space around him.
A cosmic vision of Shiva encompassing gods, elements, stars, and worlds within his boundless form.
